name: wsdot-mcp-server
description: Query WA highway conditions, ferry schedules and fares, vessel locations, toll rates, border waits, and alerts via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE.title: WSDOT Access Code
WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE.description: WSDOT Traveler API access code. Register at wsdot.wa.gov/Traffic/api/.

WSDOT_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp page limits
WSDOT_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Clamp a paged tool's limit above its maximum (500; 20 for terminal space) to that maximum, with a notice. Set false to reject it instead.
